history.summary: The Vales is a 2017 99LH Executive Condominium in Sengkang (D19) — a 3BR at $1.55M / $1,715 psf, 240m from Cheng Lim LRT. As a fully-privatising-track EC the value proposition is decent for own-stay/upgraders, but $1,715 psf is high for a Sengkang EC and there's no URA data in the dossier.
history.rating_rationale: score_1000 572 is the batch's strongest among the data-light entries, reflecting a liquid $1.55M family quantum and LRT-doorstep convenience (240m). The Vales is an EC, so it benefits from the post-MOP/privatisation price step-up that lifts EC appreciation. Caveats: $1,715 psf is toward the top of the Sengkang EC range (limited headroom), no URA appreciation/txn data, and 99LH from 2017. PDD/CRL in greater Punggol is a regional tailwind but not at this doorstep. Net Neutral, top-of-band.
red_flags: No URA appreciation/transaction data in dossier
$1,715 psf is high for a Sengkang EC — limited upside headroom
LRT (not MRT) connectivity; transfer needed for NE-line/CBD trips
catalysts: Executive Condo privatisation/full-private status lifting price ceiling
240m to Cheng Lim LRT and a liquid $1.55M family quantum
Greater Punggol (PDD) and CRL momentum supporting D19 demand
